task: Equipment Master xlsx refresh — backend endpoints + EquipmentCombo UX + Admin upload panel
summary: All 9/9 backend pytest tests pass and all 3 frontend smoke flows verified end-to-end. GET /api/equipment-master returns 589 units with {categories, items, grouped, count}; category filter Excavators returns 35. /api/admin/login with Happy123! returns a 64-char token; bad password 401. /api/admin/equipment-master/status requires admin (401 without, 200 with) and returns count+categories+last_updated+seed_file. /api/admin/equipment-master/upload replaces the MongoDB collection AND /app/backend/data/equipment_master.json on disk, creates a .bak.json backup of the prior seed, rejects non-xlsx with 400, and is 401 without admin token; after upload /api/equipment-master count == upload count and last_updated advances. Frontend: /admin shows EquipmentMasterPanel with 589 units, last updated timestamp, per-category chips, and a Pick .xlsx button. /equipment/submit — selecting Excavator reveals the EquipmentCombo (equipment-unit-input/toggle), opening it shows a grouped dropdown, typing EXC-0018 filters to 1 Excavators match, picking it fills 'EXC-0018 — 2025 HYUNDAI HX355ALCRD' and auto-fills Make. /daily/submit — Add Equipment reveals equipment-description-0-toggle which opens the same grouped picker.

issues: When equipment_type=Excavator the combo shows ALL 27 categories, not filtered to Excavators. User can still find/pick correctly, but passing filterCategories={['Excavators']} in NewEquipmentInspection.jsx would tighten UX. Minor/UX-only.
One background 401 in console (likely a session-info poll, non-blocking). Submission flow not affected.

critical_code_review_comments: _seed_equipment_master re-seeds only when existing_count != len(seed_items). If the JSON file is edited but ends up with the same count, the DB will stay stale. Consider hashing the file or comparing mtime-vs-doc-updated-at to be bulletproof.

EquipmentCombo loads the full 589-unit master list into a module-level _cache (loadMaster). Good for perf but the cache is never invalidated — after an admin xlsx upload, open tabs keep showing the OLD fleet until hard reload. Add a lightweight pub/sub or re-fetch on window focus / after upload success.
server.py is now 3159 lines — keep planning to split into modules (equipment, incidents, daily, admin, crew_hub).
test_upload_replaces_fleet_and_seed_file leaves a new .bak.json behind every run — /app/backend/data/ will accumulate backups over time. Add a retention policy (keep last N) in the upload endpoint.
test_credentials: Legacy admin password Happy123! (used for /admin/login and X-Admin-Token). Crew Hub users not required for these tests.
seed_data_creation: Each run of test_upload_replaces_fleet_and_seed_file writes a new timestamped /app/backend/data/equipment_master.YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.bak.json. Main seed JSON is re-written in-place with the freshly parsed xlsx (same 589 units).
context_for_next_testing_agent: data-testids verified: equipment-master-panel, equipment-master-total, equipment-master-upload-btn, equipment-master-refresh-btn, equipment-master-file-input, equipment-unit-input, equipment-unit-toggle, equipment-unit-panel, equipment-unit-search, equipment-unit-item-<category>-<idx>, equipment-description-0-toggle/panel/search. Backend routes: GET /api/equipment-master, GET /api/admin/equipment-master/status, POST /api/admin/equipment-master/upload (multipart 'file' + optional 'sheet' form field, defaults 'Louis'). conftest.py auto-injects X-Admin-Token into all requests.* calls, so for unauthenticated negative tests use urllib with a custom User-Agent (Cloudflare blocks python-urllib's default UA with 403).
